CIHub is a test tracking and monitoring tool that aggregates test results across your stack in real time.

#### Flaky test identification

See which tests are most disruptive to continuous deployments, with automatic flaky test identification and analysis over time.

#### Deep performance analysis

Integration with your test framework and programming language means you get in-depth performance analysis, such as identifying external dependency bottlenecks.
We integrate with any CI system so you can track affected builds, historical runs and trend graphs.

#### Realtime results

No waiting 24h for results. Follow the evolution of your test suite run in realtime, get immediate performance insights, set up alerts and take actions quickly.

##### Installation Notes

It's recommended to install CIHub directly through your [CIHub](https://dashboard.cihub.io) workspace. Please note that your GitHub organization and/or GitHub account can only be associated with a single CIHub workspace.
